exports.name: int_abs
exports.doc: int_abs(x) = |x|. The Int minimum is excluded by precondition: its absolute value is not representable in Int (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.2, frozen domain note).

exports.name: int_sign
exports.doc: int_sign(x) = -1 when x is negative, 0 when x is zero, 1 when x is positive (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.2). The Int minimum maps to -1; no exclusion is needed.

exports.name: int_min
exports.doc: int_min(a, b) = the smaller of a and b; equal arguments give that value (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.2).

exports.name: int_max
exports.doc: int_max(a, b) = the larger of a and b; equal arguments give that value (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.2).

exports.name: int_clamp
exports.doc: int_clamp(x, lo, hi) = x confined to [lo, hi]: lo when x is below, hi when x is above, x between (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.2). Requires lo <= hi; at lo = hi every x gives lo.

exports.name: int_is_even
exports.doc: int_is_even(x) = true iff 2 divides x, sign-independent: -4 is even, -3 is not (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.2).

exports.name: int_is_odd
exports.doc: int_is_odd(x) = true iff 2 does not divide x; the exact complement of int_is_even, negatives included (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.2).

exports.name: char_is_digit
exports.doc: char_is_digit(c) = true iff c is in '0'..='9' (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.3).

exports.name: char_is_alpha
exports.doc: char_is_alpha(c) = true iff c is in 'A'..='Z' or 'a'..='z' — ASCII letters only (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.3).

exports.name: char_is_whitespace
exports.doc: char_is_whitespace(c) = true iff c is one of space, tab, newline, carriage return — the standing tokenizer spec's is_whitespace contract, adopted unchanged (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.3).

exports.name: char_is_uppercase
exports.doc: char_is_uppercase(c) = true iff c is in 'A'..='Z'; non-letters give false (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.3).

exports.name: char_is_lowercase
exports.doc: char_is_lowercase(c) = true iff c is in 'a'..='z'; non-letters give false (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.3).

exports.name: char_to_digit
exports.doc: char_to_digit(c) = Some(d) when c is in '0'..='9' with d the digit's value, None for every other char (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.3).

exports.name: string_is_empty
exports.doc: string_is_empty(s) = true iff s is the empty string: len(s) == 0 (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.4).

exports.name: result_unwrap_or
exports.doc: result_unwrap_or(r, d) = the Ok payload of r, or d when r is Err (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.5).

exports.name: option_unwrap_or
exports.doc: option_unwrap_or(o, d) = the Some payload of o, or d when o is None (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.5).

exports.name: option_ok_or
exports.doc: option_ok_or(o, e) = Ok(v) when o is Some(v), or Err(e) with e unchanged when o is None (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.5).

exports.name: list_is_empty
exports.doc: list_is_empty(xs) = true iff xs has no elements: len(xs) == 0 (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.6). Tier-1.

exports.name: list_reverse
exports.doc: list_reverse(xs) = the elements of xs in reverse order; empty gives empty, a singleton gives itself (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.6). Tier-1: Z3-verified and executed-exact on the full battery (the 1.3 list-encoder campaign, LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3).

exports.name: list_contains
exports.doc: list_contains(xs, x) = true iff some element of xs equals x; the empty list gives false (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.6). Tier-1: Z3-verified and executed-exact on the full battery (the 1.3 list-encoder campaign, LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3).

exports.name: list_sum
exports.doc: list_sum(xs) = the sum of the elements of xs; the empty list gives 0. Arithmetic is the language's standing Int arithmetic (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.6). Tier-1: Z3-verified and executed-exact on the full battery (the 1.3 list-encoder campaign, LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3).

exports.name: list_product
exports.doc: list_product(xs) = the product of the elements of xs; the empty list gives 1, and any zero element gives 0 (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.6). Tier-1: Z3-verified and executed-exact on the full battery (the 1.3 list-encoder campaign, LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3).

exports.name: list_min
exports.doc: list_min(xs) = Some(m) with m the least element of xs, or None when xs is empty — the empty case is a value, not a precondition (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.6). Tier-1: Z3-verified and executed-exact on the full battery (the 1.3 list-encoder campaign, LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3).

exports.name: list_max
exports.doc: list_max(xs) = Some(m) with m the greatest element of xs, or None when xs is empty — the empty case is a value, not a precondition (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.6). Tier-1: Z3-verified and executed-exact on the full battery (the 1.3 list-encoder campaign, LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3).

exports.name: list_take
exports.doc: list_take(xs, n) = the first n elements of xs, with n clamped into [0, len(xs)]: n <= 0 gives the empty list, n >= len(xs) gives xs unchanged (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.6). Tier-1: Z3-verified and executed-exact on the full battery (the 1.3 list-encoder campaign, LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3).

exports.name: list_drop
exports.doc: list_drop(xs, n) = xs without its first n elements, with n clamped into [0, len(xs)]: n <= 0 gives xs unchanged, n >= len(xs) gives the empty list (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.6). Tier-1: Z3-verified and executed-exact on the full battery (the 1.3 list-encoder campaign, LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3).

exports.name: list_is_sorted
exports.doc: list_is_sorted(xs) = true iff xs is non-strictly ascending (every adjacent pair a <= b); the empty list and singletons give true. The library form of Appendix A's is_sorted (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.6). Tier-1: Z3-verified and executed-exact on the full battery (the 1.3 list-encoder campaign, LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3).

exports.name: list_sort
exports.doc: list_sort(xs) = the elements of xs in non-strict ascending order; the output is a permutation of the input, judged on the executed battery (the is_permutation Predicate form is not a shipped entry, STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.7). Empty and singleton lists give themselves (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.6). Tier-2: executed-exact on the full battery; standing residue at 1.3 — row 1 is the is_permutation Predicate (unencoded, 3.10) and row 3 a two-binder forall past the Phase 94 envelope (LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3.3).

exports.name: list_binary_search
exports.doc: list_binary_search(xs, x) = Some(i) with xs[i] == x when x occurs in the sorted list xs, or None when it does not. With duplicate targets any valid index satisfies the contract — the specific index is spec-silent. Hand body at the executed standard (the G5 scope-around, STDLIB_SCOPE.md 2.6): the body is a scan, because generated Rust cannot index a Vec by an Int variable (the language has no usize — G5), so the While-form binary search cannot compile; the frozen contract is the search semantics above, and per-entry complexity is deliberately outside the gate (STDLIB_SCOPE.md 3). Tier-2: executed-exact on the full battery; at 1.3 its element rows encode, but its require: is not assumable in the crown route — list_is_sorted's contract is quantifier-shaped, with no expression-level denotation for the precondition machinery — so no Verified claim is made (LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3.3; Phase 144 measurement).

exports.name: list_map
exports.doc: list_map(xs, f) = the list of f applied to each element of xs, in order; the empty list gives the empty list (STDLIB_SCOPE.md Amendment 2). Tier-1: Z3-verified and executed-exact on the full battery (the 1.3 list-encoder campaign, LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3).

exports.name: list_filter
exports.doc: list_filter(xs, p) = the elements of xs for which p holds, in their original order; the empty list gives the empty list, and a predicate that holds for no element gives the empty list (STDLIB_SCOPE.md Amendment 2). Tier-1: Z3-verified of exactly its two frozen rows and executed-exact on the full battery (LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3.3).

exports.name: list_fold
exports.doc: list_fold(xs, init, f) = the left fold of xs under f, starting from the accumulator init: f(f(f(init, x0), x1), ...) in element order; the empty list gives init (STDLIB_SCOPE.md Amendment 2). Tier-1: Z3-verified and executed-exact on the full battery (the 1.3 list-encoder campaign, LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3).

exports.name: list_all
exports.doc: list_all(xs, p) = true iff p holds for every element of xs; the empty list gives true (vacuous truth) (STDLIB_SCOPE.md Amendment 2). Tier-1: Z3-verified and executed-exact on the full battery (the 1.3 list-encoder campaign, LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3).

exports.name: list_any
exports.doc: list_any(xs, p) = true iff p holds for at least one element of xs; the empty list gives false (STDLIB_SCOPE.md Amendment 2). Tier-1: Z3-verified and executed-exact on the full battery (the 1.3 list-encoder campaign, LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3).

exports.name: range
exports.doc: range(lo, hi) = the ascending list [lo, lo + 1, ..., hi - 1]; lo == hi gives the empty list, and lo > hi gives the empty list — there is no descending form and no precondition (STDLIB_SCOPE.md Amendment 2). Tier-1: Z3-verified and executed-exact on the full battery (the 1.3 list-encoder campaign, LIST_ENCODER_SCOPE.md 3).
